answer: The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. Quantity surveyor membership with project cost records is the check: costs recorded for one practice across projects. A farm faking 243 aliases needs 243 separate cost records, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the nebula signal is public, the vault check is automatic, and 243 aliases cost 243 times what one real agent costs, with the karst trail open to all.
